title: Canoe, the Giraffe Walks Past way

objects.source: drawn by agent: the pale strip of beach between the trees and the lake: its top edge and the water's edge, two near-level lines; no Quick, Draw! category is a shoreline

cast.source: quickdraw:5064209014456320 as a rig (2 parts, root stern to bow); 20 keys placed by eye over SAM silhouettes (pose_agent_v4.json)

xsheet.note: The canoe enters at the left edge, stern still out of frame; the paddle reaches forward.
The stern paddler lifts the paddle toward upright.
The paddle is upright, blade down in the water.
The paddle has pulled through and swings back past the paddler.
The paddle trails behind, low toward the stern, as the canoe glides.
The bow reaches the right edge of the frame; the canoe is larger as it comes nearer.
The bow is out of frame at the right; the paddle still trails.

camera_source: phase correlation of the treeline and shore band (rows 10-75) frame to frame, accumulated and smoothed over 5 frames, scaled by the far plane's depth so the trees slide exactly as measured (about 50 px left and 8 px down over the shot). camera.json was not used: its values follow the canoe, which SAM's mask did not fully remove, and run 150 px the wrong way.
